scenes.purpose: Introduce the topic of elections and their importance.
scenes.teacher_script: Hello Class 8! Today, we're going to learn about a very important process in our country: the elections. It's how we choose our leaders!

template_data.title: The Process of Elections in India
template_data.subtitle: Choosing Our Representatives

scenes.purpose: Explain the general idea and frequency of state assembly elections.
scenes.teacher_script: Elections for state assemblies, like the one in Telangana, are usually held every five years. This is when we decide who will represent us as MLAs!

scenes.purpose: Detail who is eligible to contest in these elections.
scenes.teacher_script: Anyone who wants to become an MLA needs to meet certain requirements. They must be an Indian citizen and at least 25 years old.

scenes.purpose: Distinguish between candidates from political parties and independent candidates.
scenes.teacher_script: Candidates usually belong to political parties, but some individuals also contest on their own. These are called 'Independents'.

bullets: Belong to a political party (e.g., Congress, BJP)
Represent their party's ideology and symbol
Supported by party resources and members
Do not belong to any political party
Contest on their own personal merit
Must register their own unique symbol

scenes.purpose: Explain the role of election manifestos and campaigns.
scenes.teacher_script: Before elections, candidates and parties release manifestos, which are promises of what they'll do if elected. They also hold meetings and visit voters door-to-door to campaign.

attributes.label: Election Manifestos
attributes.value: Promises and programs for the public

attributes.label: Purpose
attributes.value: Convince voters and explain their vision

scenes.purpose: Clarify the concepts of voters and constituencies.
scenes.teacher_script: To vote, you need to be a registered voter in your area. Our state is divided into smaller voting areas called constituencies, and each one elects one MLA.

attributes.label: Constituency
attributes.value: Area from which one representative is elected

scenes.purpose: Summarize the major steps in the election process.
scenes.teacher_script: The election process follows several key steps: from announcing the election to finally declaring the results.

scenes.purpose: Test the student's understanding with a quick question.
scenes.teacher_script: Now, let's see what you've learned! Here's a quick question for you.

template_data.question: What is an 'Election Manifesto' in the context of Indian elections?
options: A list of all candidates contesting the election.
A document outlining the promises and programs of a political party or candidate.
The official results sheet of an election.
